The following table describes the fields for the appinfo event.
Field name
Description
Example value
aid
The sensor ID. This value is
unique to each installation of
a Falcon sensor. When a
sensor is updated or
reinstalled, the host gets a
new aid. In those situations,
a single host could have
multiple aid values over time.
"85ae98xxxxxxd9a8f2"
BrowserExtensionBrowserName
The name of the browser
that the browser extension is
installed on.
"Google Chrome"
BrowserExtensionEnabled
Whether the browser
extension is enabled on at
least one browser profile on
the asset.
"true"
Data for seeing additional environment info (secondary events) [/documentation/page/fa572b1c/falcon-data-replicator#g905b0d0]

1224/1226
Field name
Description
Example value
BrowserExtensionID
The ID of the browser
extension.
"abxxxxxxxxxxxxyz"
BrowserExtensionInstallations
A list of values about the
browser extension's
installation, formatted as "
<installed_by_user>:
<browser_profile>:
<install_method>".
"KLane:Work Profile:Developer Mode"
BrowserExtensionPermissions
The browser permissions
that the browser extension
requires to run.
"privacy"
BrowserExtensionPermissionSeverity
The severity of all browser
permissions requested by
the browser extension as
determined automatically.
"Critical"
Category
The category the application
is in.
"Web Browsers"
cid
The customer ID.
0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV-WX
CompanyName
The name of the company.
"Google Inc."
detectioncount
The number of detections.
"1"
externalIP
The external IPv4 address of
the asset the application is
on.
"192.0.2.71"
FileName
The name of the file.
"googleupdate.exe"
hostname
The hostname of the asset
the application is on.
"ABC-123-DEF-456"
installationTimestamp
The date and time the
application was installed, if
available.
"2022-03-16T01:51:24Z"
ProductName
The name of the product.
"Microsoft Exchange"
ProductVersion
The version of the product.
"15.0"
SHA256HashData
The file hash bashed on
SHA-256.
"69061e33acb7587d773d05000390f9101f71dfd6eed7973b551594eaf3f04193"
SoftwareType
The type of software.
"browser_extension"
_time
The host's local time in
epoch format.
"1538648887.051"
